name: jsonlint-lab
description: Local zero-auth MCP for JSON lint heuristics — modes (compact / pretty / validate / quiet) from pasted CLI/config, option counts (--compact / --in-place / --quiet / --indent / --validate / -c / -i / -q), sort-key hints (--sort-keys / sortKeys / sorted / key order), and lite lint — pasted source only, never runs jsonlint CLI, no network.
